lede: The Telluride Medical Center board meets Thursday with a possible vote on a Two Site Model for the new hospital facility — a decision that will shape what gets built and where for decades to come. Also Thursday, the TMVOA board takes up the formation of a Workforce Housing Committee and votes on updated policies. Monday, Town Council opens with a work session on Comprehensive Plan goals and a review of proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies — that one matters to anyone who lives or works in employee housing here.

notable.stake: Board may vote on Two Site Model shaping the new hospital's location and scale.
Board votes on updated policies and forming a Workforce Housing Committee.
Council reviews third-party audit proposals for Town rental housing policies.
